name: Self-Healing CI Pipeline
description: Webhook server that detects failed GitHub Actions runs and fixes them automatically using Ruff, Black, and Claude AI. Comment /heal on a PR to apply the AI-suggested patch.

name: Min-Crop Stabilizer
description: Rust video stabilizer that removes jitter below a percentage-of-frame threshold, keeps pans as intentional motion, and crops only as much as the largest jitter that actually occurred. Includes a CLI, local web app, and Windows desktop build.
